Chooses how painted surfaces are mixed with what is already on the screen: 1 alpha (the default), 2 multiply, 3 add, 4 stochastic alpha (see [EntityBlend](EntityBlend)). Any other number selects the default.
@param brush  The brush.
@param blend  1, 2, 3 or 4.
